property.$description: Tokens for the PropertyCard parts (media, header, facts, price, broker identity). Measured from the audit's captured DOM of AcmeCo's search-results and map cards (audit family F28: 742 instances, 23 variants, 54 designs). One type scale for list and map views, where AcmeCo changes size by page on the same card. Decision 27.

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 14px bold in the full-width list, 19px bold in the map view, for the same listing; became 18px everywhere.

gap.$description: PROPOSED: between the left (title, address) and right (size, city) columns.

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 12px in the list and 16px in the map view; became 14px everywhere.

description-color.$description: PROPOSED: the listing description in secondary grey, 5.77:1, so the facts lead.

divider.$description: OBSERVED: a thin vertical line between facts and description.

font-size.$description: PROPOSED: price lifted as the first fact, semibold (decision 27).

prominent-font-size.$description: PROPOSED: the larger price on the property detail page.

muted-color.$description: OBSERVED: 'Price Upon Request' is common; shown in secondary grey (5.77:1) so real prices stand out.

background.$description: OBSERVED: grey shows while photos load (several photos hadn't loaded when captured).

inset.$description: PROPOSED: 12px from the photo edges to the save button and labels.

radius.$description: PROPOSED: 4px on thumbnails (tier 3); larger photos follow the card's corners.

action-gap.$description: PROPOSED: 8px between the buttons on a photo (Ask AcmeCo beside Save; decision 45).

gap.$description: OBSERVED: logo and broker photos in one row.

avatar-size.$description: OBSERVED: 50px square broker photos; became 48px (4px grid).

avatar-size-lg.$description: OBSERVED: 80px broker photos in the property detail page's contact box (ContactModule).

avatar-radius.$description: OBSERVED: square photos; 4px softens them (decision 26: images are content, not surfaces).

avatar-text.$description: PROPOSED: initials on the placeholder avatar (no real people).

logo-height.$description: OBSERVED: logos up to 34-40px tall (tier 3: 80 x 34px); 40px maximum, the first rule for third-party marks (the benchmark lesson 8).

name-font-size-lg.$description: OBSERVED: 18px broker names in the contact box.

logo-border.$description: PROPOSED: outline of the placeholder logo mark (no real company logos).
